blog.title: i found a tape in the camcorder (not mine)
blog.body: ok so dads camcorder had a tape in it from b4 i got it. i figured it was blank. nope. its me. im like 3. im on a tricycle on the driveway n i fall off it 41 TIMES (i counted, it took the whole tape). every time i get up n get back on n dad is behind the camera going 'again. again. u got it.' he never says 'ur done' or 'be careful.' just again. bro. thats where i got it. i been falling off stuff 4 16 years n getting back up n i thought it was just me being stubborn but its like, a family thing. i watched it 5 times. i didnt tell dad. i just asked if i could keep the camcorder thru the winter n he said 'u can have it, mike.' he didnt even ask why. ok im not crying its the dust off the tape

blog.title: tire king: a skaters guide 2 the 5:48 tire change
blog.body: so i work at tire king mon-wed 7 to 3. its not skating but its basically skating bc its all balance n not caring about ur hands. the secret: u dont lift the tire, u ROLL it, like a board. fastest change on the crew is me, 5:48 for 4 tires, boss gave me a coupon 4 free wings. i didnt tell anyone 4 a month bc skaters r supposed 2 not b good at anything useful. then a lady came in w/ a minivan n 4 bald tires n a baby in the back n i did it in 6 flat n she said 'ur an angel' n i went home n thought abt it 4 an hour. i am not an angel. i am a guy who has fallen off 800 things. but i guess a person can b both. also the shop floor is SMOOTH. no cracks. i skate it on my break. the boss knows. he calls it 'safety inspection.'

blog.title: dana is 12 n she can ollie (a statement)
blog.body: my sister dana asked me 2 teach her 2 ollie. i said ok, 3 weeks, maybe 4, it took me 8 MONTHS. i had the whole speech ready. step 1, foot on the tail. she did. she popped it. the board went up. she landed on it. rolled like 4 feet. looked at me like 'is that it.' bro. 4 SECONDS. 8 months of my life. she said 'its not that hard, u just have 2 not think.' i been thinking abt that sentence 4 days. i think its the truest thing anyone has ever said abt skating n i cant use it bc it came from a 12 yr old w/ a mouthful of braces. so heres the plan. i teach her the kickflip, she is better than me in a week, i film it on dads camcorder, n i become the proudest worst skater in dayton.

blog.title: how 2 fall (a guide by a professional)
blog.body: 1) never put ur hands out. thats how u meet a wrist doctor. 2) roll like a log n pretend its a flip. 3) if ur gonna fall, fall dramatic, it helps the footy. 4) always check if any1 is watching. if so, u meant it. 5) ice immediately. shins, elbow, pride, in that order. pride is the worst 1. 6) the board will b fine. the board is always fine. its just u. 7) get up first, THEN say ow. 8) if dad has the camcorder, wave. 9) if ur sister is watching n she can already ollie, say 'nice' n walk it off 4 a while behind the garage. i know my stuff bc ive fallen 800 times n only 4 of them were on purpose. 10) the best fall is the 1 u get up from n do again. my dad told me that. i think. it was on a tape.
